thread:
Maria: rolling the 2025.3.1 -> 2025.4.0 canary now. will watch p95/p99 and 5xx noise. canary set to 5% :hourglass:
DeployBot: deploy started by Maria. canary=5%, version=2025.4.0, region=us-west-2
Ryan: seeing small uptick in embed-service p95 in dashboard (dash.redwood/internal/slo/embed). +10% relative at 30s into canary
Sam: on it, pulling logs from canary hosts. running `rg "ERROR" /var/log/embed/* | tail -n 50` to see if it's new
Anya: FYI alerting rule env=prod embed_5xx_rate firing at 5m window. threshold=0.8% configured, currently 1.4%
Sam: logs show `kvcache` timeout 3x in ~120s from the new binary. stack trace points to rpc timeout in shard 2
Ryan: we have a rollback window policy at +2% 5xx sustained for 3m. this is 1.4% now but spiking. recommend pause traffic to canary and scale down canary to 0% for safety
Maria: agreed. toggling canary to 0% and pin previous version for routing while we triage. doing `deployctl update-route --version=2025.3.1 --weight=100`
DeployBot: routing update started. change id=chg_9876. canary weight -> 0% in progress
Sam: capturing core dump and uploading to staging-bucket for analyzer. also creating short eval prompt set to sanity-check model outputs post-rollback
Anya: adding annotation to incident timeline: "canary 2025.4.0 caused kvcache rpc timeouts leading to 5xx burst; rolled back to 2025.3.1 at +2m" :spiral_notepad:
Ryan: after rollback 5xx rate returned to baseline within 45s. p95 also dropped back. good. we should still run a deeper diff between versions for rpc timeout regressions
Maria: agreed. open a small revert/patch PR for the kvcache timeout knob. we should also add a temporary metric for rpc_error_type to improve future triage
Sam: +1 on metric. PR created: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4123 - includes additional logging context and increases rpc timeout from 250ms -> 400ms with feature flag behind canary
Ryan: will follow up with postmortem note on the deploy thread and add to the release notes: "rollback: 2025.4.0 due to kvcache RPC timeouts causing transient 5xx"
Maria: thanks everyone. action items: Sam - patch PR, Anya - update incident timeline & alert thresholds review, Ryan - add postmortem draft and retrospective notes, Maria - coordinate next canary once patch is validated
DeployBot: change chg_9876 completed. canary weight now 0%.
Sam: uploading short logs bundle: https://storage.redwood.internal/s/logs/embed-canary-1745678901.tar.gz
Anya: I adjusted the alerting runbook to add an immediate canary-pause step under embed_5xx_rate so next time paging has clear action
Maria: filing follow-up ticket for longer-term: add rpc_error_type histogram, add synthetic query during canary that exercises shard 2. ticket: RD-8739
Ryan: closing the thread; monitoring for 10 more minutes then moving incident to postmortem queue. :white_check_mark:
